title: विंशत्यधिकद्विशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 220 · What to do in great loss

summary.en: Yudhishthira asks what is best for a man sunk in distress, when his kin or kingdom are lost. Bhishma tells how Indra and Prahlada spoke in this matter, and how the king should hold to patience and wait for time.
summary.kn: ಬಂಧುಗಳು ಅಥವಾ ರಾಜ್ಯ ನಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಕಷ್ಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳುಗಿದ ಮನುಷ್ಯನಿಗೆ ಯಾವುದು ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠವೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಇಂದ್ರ-ಪ್ರಹ್ಲಾದರ ಸಂವಾದವನ್ನೂ ರಾಜ ತಾಳ್ಮೆಯನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿದು ಕಾಲಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಕಾಯಬೇಕೆಂಬುದನ್ನೂ ಭೀಷ್ಮ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर पूछते हैं कि बन्धुओं या राज्य के नाश से संकट में डूबे मनुष्य के लिए क्या श्रेष्ठ है। भीष्म इन्द्र और प्रह्लाद का इस विषय में संवाद और राजा के धैर्य रखकर काल की प्रतीक्षा करने की बात बताते हैं।
summary.te: బంధువులు లేదా రాజ్యం నష్టమై కష్టంలో మునిగిన మనిషికి ఏది శ్రేయస్కరమని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు. ఇంద్ర ప్రహ్లాదుల సంవాదాన్ని, రాజు ఓర్పు పట్టి కాలం కోసం వేచి ఉండాలని భీష్ముడు చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: உறவினரோ நாடோ இழந்து துயரில் மூழ்கிய மனிதனுக்கு எது சிறந்தது என்று யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, இது பற்றி இந்திரனும் பிரகலாதனும் பேசியதையும் மன்னன் பொறுமை காத்துக் காலத்துக்காகக் காத்திருக்க வேண்டும் என்பதையும் பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: ബന്ധുക്കളോ രാജ്യമോ നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ട് ദുരിതത്തിൽ മുങ്ങിയ മനുഷ്യന് എന്താണ് ഉത്തമമെന്ന് യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. ഈ വിഷയത്തിൽ ഇന്ദ്രനും പ്രഹ്ലാദനും തമ്മിൽ സംസാരിച്ചതെങ്ങനെയെന്ന് ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു; ക്ഷമയോടെ നിൽക്കുകയും കാലത്തിനായി കാത്തിരിക്കുകയും വേണമെന്ന് രാജാവിനോട് പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.220; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
मग्नस्य व्यसने कृच्छ्रे किं श्रेयः पुरुषस्य हि ।
बन्धुनाशे महीपाल राज्यनाशेऽपि वा पुनः ॥

meaning.en: For a man sunk in a hard calamity, in the loss of kin or even of his kingdom, O king, what is best?

verses.text:
त्वं हि नः परमो वक्ता लोकेऽस्मिन्भरतर्षभ ।
एतद्भवन्तं पृच्छामि तन्मे वक्तुमिहार्हसि ॥

meaning.en: You are our best teacher in this world, bull of the Bharatas; I ask you this, so you should tell me.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
पुत्रदारैः सुखैश्चैव वियुक्तस्य धनेन च ।
मग्नस्य व्यसने कृच्छ्रे धृतिः श्रेयस्करी नृप ॥

meaning.en: For one parted from sons, wife, comforts and wealth, and sunk in hard calamity, steadiness is best, O king.

verses.text:
धैर्येण युक्तस्य सतः शरीरं न विशीर्यते ।
आरोग्याच्च शरीरस्य स पुनर्विन्दते श्रियम् ॥

meaning.en: The body of a steady man does not waste away; with the body's health he wins fortune again.

verses.text:
यस्य राज्ञो नरास्तात सात्त्विकीं वृत्तिमास्थिताः ।
तस्य स्थैर्यं च धैर्यं च व्यवसायश्च कर्मसु ॥

meaning.en: Dear son, the king whose men follow a life of sattva has firmness, steadiness and resolve in his undertakings.

verses.text:
अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् ।
बलिवासवसंवादं पुनरेव युधिष्ठिर ॥

meaning.en: On this they again tell this ancient account, Yudhishthira, of the conversation between Bali and Indra.

verses.text:
वृत्ते देवासुरे युद्धे दैत्यदानवसंक्षये ।
विष्णुक्रान्तेषु लोकेषु देवराजे शतक्रतौ ॥

meaning.en: When the war of gods and asuras was over, the Daityas and Danavas destroyed, the worlds taken in Vishnu's strides, and Indra, Shatakratu, king of the gods,

verses.text:
इज्यमानेषु देवेषु चातुर्वर्ण्ये व्यवस्थिते ।
समृध्यमाने त्रैलोक्ये प्रीतियुक्ते स्वयंभुवि ॥

meaning.en: when the gods were worshipped, the four classes in order, the three worlds prospering and the Self-born pleased,

verses.text:
रुद्रैर्वसुभिरादित्यैरश्विभ्यामपि चर्षिभिः ।
गन्धर्वैर्भुजगेन्द्रैश्च सिद्धैश्चान्यैर्वृतः प्रभुः ॥

meaning.en: the lord, surrounded by Rudras, Vasus, Adityas, the two Ashvins, sages, Gandharvas, great serpents, Siddhas and others,

verses.text:
चतुर्दन्तं सुदान्तं च वारणेन्द्रं श्रिया वृतम् ।
आरुह्यैरावतं शक्रस्त्रैलोक्यमनुसंययौ ॥

meaning.en: mounted Airavata, the four-tusked, well-tamed best of elephants, wrapped in splendour, and went about the three worlds.

verses.text:
स कदाचित्समुद्रान्ते कस्मिंश्चिद्गिरिगह्वरे ।
बलिं वैरोचनिं वज्री ददर्शोपससर्प च ॥

meaning.en: Once, in a mountain cave at the edge of the sea, the thunderbolt-wielder saw Bali, son of Virochana, and went near him.

verses.text:
तमैरावतमूर्धस्थं प्रेक्ष्य देवगणैर्वृतम् ।
सुरेन्द्रमिन्द्रं दैत्येन्द्रो न शुशोच न विव्यथे ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Indra, lord of gods, seated on Airavata's head and surrounded by hosts of gods, the lord of the Daityas neither grieved nor trembled.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा तमविकारस्थं तिष्ठन्तं निर्भयं बलिम् ।
अधिरूढो द्विपश्रेष्ठमित्युवाच शतक्रतुः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Bali standing unchanged and fearless, Shatakratu, mounted on the best of elephants, said:

verses.text:
दैत्य न व्यथसे शौर्यादथ वा वृद्धसेवया ।
तपसा भावितत्वाद्वा सर्वथैतत्सुदुष्करम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Daitya, you do not tremble, whether from heroism, from serving elders or from being formed by austerity; in every way this is very hard.'

verses.text:
शत्रुभिर्वशमानीतो हीनः स्थानादनुत्तमात् ।
वैरोचने किमाश्रित्य शोचितव्ये न शोचसि ॥

meaning.en: 'Brought under enemies' power, fallen from your unsurpassed place, son of Virochana, relying on what do you not grieve where grief is due?'

verses.text:
श्रैष्ठ्यं प्राप्य स्वजातीनां भुक्त्वा भोगाननुत्तमान् ।
हृतस्वबलराज्यस्त्वं ब्रूहि कस्मान्न शोचसि ॥

meaning.en: 'Having reached the foremost place among your kin and enjoyed unsurpassed pleasures, robbed of your own strength and kingdom, say why you do not grieve.'

verses.text:
ईश्वरो हि पुरा भूत्वा पितृपैतामहे पदे ।
तत्त्वमद्य हृतं दृष्ट्वा सपत्नैः किं न शोचसि ॥

meaning.en: 'Once lord in your fathers' and grandfathers' place, now seeing it taken by rivals, why do you not grieve?'

verses.text:
बद्धश्च वारुणैः पाशैर्वज्रेण च समाहतः ।
हृतदारो हृतधनो ब्रूहि कस्मान्न शोचसि ॥

meaning.en: 'Bound by Varuna's nooses and struck with the thunderbolt, your wives and wealth taken, say why you do not grieve.'

verses.text:
भ्रष्टश्रीर्विभवभ्रष्टो यन्न शोचसि दुष्करम् ।
त्रैलोक्यराज्यनाशे हि कोऽन्यो जीवितुमुत्सहेत् ॥

meaning.en: 'That you do not grieve, fallen from fortune and wealth, is hard indeed; who else could wish to live after losing rule of the three worlds?'

verses.text:
एतच्चान्यच्च परुषं ब्रुवन्तं परिभूय तम् ।
श्रुत्वा सुखमसंभ्रान्तो बलिर्वैरोचनोऽब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing this and more harsh talk, as he was scorned, Bali son of Virochana answered calmly, without agitation.

verses.text:
निगृहीते मयि भृशं शक्र किं कत्थितेन ते ।
वज्रमुद्यम्य तिष्ठन्तं पश्यामि त्वां पुरंदर ॥

meaning.en: 'Indra, why boast of me, who am thoroughly held down? I see you standing with the thunderbolt raised, Purandara.'

verses.text:
अशक्तः पूर्वमासीस्त्वं कथंचिच्छक्ततां गतः ।
कस्त्वदन्य इमा वाचः सुक्रूरा वक्तुमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: 'You were once powerless and somehow became powerful; who but you could speak such very cruel words?'

verses.text:
यस्तु शत्रोर्वशस्थस्य शक्तोऽपि कुरुते दयाम् ।
हस्तप्राप्तस्य वीरस्य तं चैव पुरुषं विदुः ॥

meaning.en: 'One who, though able, shows mercy to an enemy under his power, a hero fallen into his hands, is also known as a true man.'

verses.text:
अनिश्चयो हि युद्धेषु द्वयोर्विवदमानयोः ।
एकः प्राप्नोति विजयमेकश्चैव पराभवम् ॥

meaning.en: 'There is no certainty in wars between two who contend: one wins, and one is defeated.'

verses.text:
मा च ते भूत्स्वभावोऽयं मया दैवतपुंगव ।
ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां विक्रमेण जितो बलात् ॥

meaning.en: 'Let this not be your nature, bull among gods: that you, lord of all beings, were conquered by me with strength and valour.'

verses.text:
नैतदस्मत्कृतं शक्र नैतच्छक्र त्वया कृतम् ।
यत्त्वमेवंगतो वज्रिन्यद्वाप्येवंगता वयम् ॥

meaning.en: 'This was not done by me, Indra, nor by you, that you are as you are, wielder of the thunderbolt, and that we are as we are.'

verses.text:
अहमासं यथाद्य त्वं भविता त्वं यथा वयम् ।
मावमंस्था मया कर्म दुष्कृतं कृतमित्युत ॥

meaning.en: 'I was once as you are today, and you will be as we are; do not despise me as if I had done a wrong deed.'

verses.text:
सुखदुःखे हि पुरुषः पर्यायेणाधिगच्छति ।
पर्यायेणासि शक्रत्वं प्राप्तः शक्र न कर्मणा ॥

meaning.en: 'A man comes to pleasure and pain in turn; you have attained Indra's rank by turn, Indra, not by action.'

verses.text:
कालः काले नयति मां त्वां च कालो नयत्ययम् ।
तेनाहं त्वं यथा नाद्य त्वं चापि न यथा वयम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Time brings me in its time and brings you; by it I am not now as you are, and you too will not be as we are.'

verses.text:
न मातृपितृशुश्रूषा न च दैवतपूजनम् ।
नान्यो गुणसमाचारः पुरुषस्य सुखावहः ॥

meaning.en: 'Service of mother and father, worship of the gods, no other good conduct brings a man happiness.'

verses.text:
न विद्या न तपो दानं न मित्राणि न बान्धवाः ।
शक्नुवन्ति परित्रातुं नरं कालेन पीडितम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Not learning, austerity, gifts, friends or kin can save a man pressed by time.'

verses.text:
नागामिनमनर्थं हि प्रतिघातशतैरपि ।
शक्नुवन्ति प्रतिव्योढुमृते बुद्धिबलान्नराः ॥

meaning.en: 'Men cannot bear coming misfortune even with hundreds of counter-measures, except through the strength of understanding.'

verses.text:
पर्यायैर्हन्यमानानां परित्राता न विद्यते ।
इदं तु दुःखं यच्छक्र कर्ताहमिति मन्यते ॥

meaning.en: 'For those struck by the turns of fortune there is no saviour; and this is sorrow, Indra, that one thinks, I am the doer.'

verses.text:
यदि कर्ता भवेत्कर्ता न क्रियेत कदाचन ।
यस्मात्तु क्रियते कर्ता तस्मात्कर्ताप्यनीश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: 'If a doer were the doer, he would never be made; since the doer is made, even the doer has no mastery.'

verses.text:
कालेन त्वाहमजयं कालेनाहं जितस्त्वया ।
गन्ता गतिमतां कालः कालः कलयति प्रजाः ॥

meaning.en: 'By time I conquered you, and by time I was conquered by you; time is the goer of all who go, time brings the creatures to an end.'

verses.text:
इन्द्र प्राकृतया बुद्ध्या प्रलपन्नावबुध्यसे ।
केचित्त्वां बहु मन्यन्ते श्रैष्ठ्यं प्राप्तं स्वकर्मणा ॥

meaning.en: 'Indra, you babble with a common mind and do not understand; some think highly of you as having reached eminence by your own action.'

verses.text:
कथमस्मद्विधो नाम जानँल्लोकप्रवृत्तयः ।
कालेनाभ्याहतः शोचेन्मुह्येद्वाप्यर्थसंभ्रमे ॥

meaning.en: 'How could one like me, knowing the ways of the world, struck by time, grieve or be bewildered in a tumult of affairs?'

verses.text:
नित्यं कालपरीतस्य मम वा मद्विधस्य वा ।
बुद्धिर्व्यसनमासाद्य भिन्ना नौरिव सीदति ॥

meaning.en: 'For me, or one like me, always surrounded by time, the mind in calamity sinks like a broken boat.'

verses.text:
अहं च त्वं च ये चान्ये भविष्यन्ति सुराधिपाः ।
ते सर्वे शक्र यास्यन्ति मार्गमिन्द्रशतैर्गतम् ॥

meaning.en: 'I, you, and the other lords of the gods who will come, all will go, Indra, by the road gone by hundreds of Indras.'

verses.text:
त्वामप्येवं सुदुर्धर्षं ज्वलन्तं परया श्रिया ।
काले परिणते कालः कालयिष्यति मामिव ॥

meaning.en: 'You too, hard to withstand and blazing with supreme glory, when the time is ripe, Time will drive off just as me.'

verses.text:
बहूनीन्द्रसहस्राणि दैतेयानां युगे युगे ।
अभ्यतीतानि कालेन कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: 'Many thousands of Indras of the Daityas, age after age, have passed by time; for time is hard to cross.'

verses.text:
इदं तु लब्ध्वा त्वं स्थानमात्मानं बहु मन्यसे ।
सर्वभूतभवं देवं ब्रह्माणमिव शाश्वतम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Having gained this place, you think highly of yourself, like Brahma, the eternal god, source of all beings.'

verses.text:
न चेदमचलं स्थानमनन्तं वापि कस्यचित् ।
त्वं तु बालिशया बुद्ध्या ममेदमिति मन्यसे ॥

meaning.en: 'This place is not unmoving or endless for anyone; but with a childish mind you think, this is mine.'

verses.text:
अविश्वास्ये विश्वसिषि मन्यसे चाध्रुवं ध्रुवम् ।
ममेयमिति मोहात्त्वं राजश्रियमभीप्ससि ॥

meaning.en: 'You trust what is untrustworthy and take the unstable for stable; from delusion you hanker for royal fortune as though it were mine.'

verses.text:
नेयं तव न चास्माकं न चान्येषां स्थिरा मता ।
अतिक्रम्य बहूनन्यांस्त्वयि तावदियं स्थिता ॥

meaning.en: 'This is not held to be lasting, not yours, nor ours, nor others'; having passed over many others, it now rests with you.'

verses.text:
कंचित्कालमियं स्थित्वा त्वयि वासव चञ्चला ।
गौर्निपानमिवोत्सृज्य पुनरन्यं गमिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: 'After staying some time with you, Indra, this fickle one will leave and go to another, like a cow leaving a drinking-trough.'

verses.text:
राजलोका ह्यतिक्रान्ता यान्न संख्यातुमुत्सहे ।
त्वत्तो बहुतराश्चान्ये भविष्यन्ति पुरंदर ॥

meaning.en: 'Worlds of kings have passed that I cannot count, and many more than you will come, Purandara.'

verses.text:
सवृक्षौषधिरत्नेयं ससरित्पर्वताकरा ।
तानिदानीं न पश्यामि यैर्भुक्तेयं पुरा मही ॥

meaning.en: 'This earth with its trees, herbs, jewels, rivers, mountains and mines: I do not now see those by whom this earth was formerly enjoyed.'

verses.text:
पृथुरैलो मयो भौमो नरकः शम्बरस्तथा ।
अश्वग्रीवः पुलोमा च स्वर्भानुरमितध्वजः ॥

meaning.en: 'Prithu, Aila, Maya, Bhauma, Naraka, Shambara, Ashvagriva, Pulomā, Svarbhanu, Amitadhvaja,'

verses.text:
प्रह्रादो नमुचिर्दक्षो विप्रचित्तिर्विरोचनः ।
ह्रीनिषेधः सुहोत्रश्च भूरिहा पुष्पवान्वृषः ॥

meaning.en: 'Prahlada, Namuci, Daksha, Vipracitti, Virochana, Hrinishedha, Suhotra, Bhurihan, Pushpavan, Vrisha,'

verses.text:
सत्येषुरृषभो राहुः कपिलाश्वो विरूपकः ।
बाणः कार्तस्वरो वह्निर्विश्वदंष्ट्रोऽथ नैरृतः ॥

meaning.en: 'Satyeshu, Rishabha, Rahu, Kapilashva, Virupaka, Bana, Kartasvara, Vahni, Vishvadamshtra and Nairrita,'

verses.text:
रित्थाहुत्थौ वीरताम्रौ वराहाश्वो रुचिः प्रभुः ।
विश्वजित्प्रतिशौरिश्च वृषाण्डो विष्करो मधुः ॥

meaning.en: 'Rittha and Huttha, Viratamra, Varahashva, Ruci, Prabhu, Vishvajit, Pratishauri, Vrishanda, Vishkara, Madhu,'

verses.text:
हिरण्यकशिपुश्चैव कैटभश्चैव दानवः ।
दैत्याश्च कालखञ्जाश्च सर्वे ते नैरृतैः सह ॥

meaning.en: 'Hiranyakashipu, the Danava Kaitabha, the Daityas, the Kalakhanjas, all of them with the Nairritas,'

verses.text:
एते चान्ये च बहवः पूर्वे पूर्वतराश्च ये ।
दैत्येन्द्रा दानवेन्द्राश्च यांश्चान्याननुशुश्रुम ॥

meaning.en: 'these and many others, earlier and still earlier, lords of Daityas and Danavas, and others of whom we have heard,'

verses.text:
बहवः पूर्वदैत्येन्द्राः संत्यज्य पृथिवीं गताः ।
कालेनाभ्याहताः सर्वे कालो हि बलवत्तरः ॥

meaning.en: 'many former lords of the Daityas abandoned the earth and went, all struck by time; for time is stronger.'

verses.text:
सर्वैः क्रतुशतैरिष्टं न त्वमेकः शतक्रतुः ।
सर्वे धर्मपराश्चासन्सर्वे सततसत्रिणः ॥

meaning.en: 'All performed hundreds of sacrifices; you are not the only Shatakratu. All were devoted to dharma and all were constant sacrificers.'

verses.text:
अन्तरिक्षचराः सर्वे सर्वेऽभिमुखयोधिनः ।
सर्वे संहननोपेताः सर्वे परिघबाहवः ॥

meaning.en: 'All moved in the sky, all fought face to face, all were strongly built, all had arms like iron bars.'

verses.text:
सर्वे मायाशतधराः सर्वे ते कामचारिणः ।
सर्वे समरमासाद्य न श्रूयन्ते पराजिताः ॥

meaning.en: 'All had hundreds of illusions, all moved as they wished; all, having come to battle, are not heard of as defeated.'

verses.text:
सर्वे सत्यव्रतपराः सर्वे कामविहारिणः ।
सर्वे वेदव्रतपराः सर्वे चासन्बहुश्रुताः ॥

meaning.en: 'All were devoted to truth and vows, all took pleasure as they willed, all kept Vedic vows, and all were much learned.'

verses.text:
सर्वे संहतमैश्वर्यमीश्वराः प्रतिपेदिरे ।
न चैश्वर्यमदस्तेषां भूतपूर्वो महात्मनाम् ॥

meaning.en: 'All as lords gained united sovereignty, yet in those great souls there was never the pride of lordship.'

verses.text:
सर्वे यथार्थदातारः सर्वे विगतमत्सराः ।
सर्वे सर्वेषु भूतेषु यथावत्प्रतिपेदिरे ॥

meaning.en: 'All gave as was due, all were free of envy, and all behaved rightly toward all beings.'

verses.text:
सर्वे दाक्षायणीपुत्राः प्राजापत्या महाबलाः ।
ज्वलन्तः प्रतपन्तश्च कालेन प्रतिसंहृताः ॥

meaning.en: 'All were sons of Daksha's daughter, descendants of Prajapati, very mighty; blazing and scorching, they were taken back by time.'

verses.text:
त्वं चैवेमां यदा भुक्त्वा पृथिवीं त्यक्ष्यसे पुनः ।
न शक्ष्यसि तदा शक्र नियन्तुं शोकमात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: 'And when you, having enjoyed this earth, give it up again, Indra, you will not be able to restrain your own grief.'

verses.text:
मुञ्चेच्छां कामभोगेषु मुञ्चेमं श्रीभवं मदम् ।
एवं स्वराज्यनाशे त्वं शोकं संप्रसहिष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: 'Give up wishes for pleasures and this pride born of fortune. Then, at the loss of your own kingdom, you will bear the grief.'

verses.text:
शोककाले शुचो मा त्वं हर्षकाले च मा हृषः ।
अतीतानागते हित्वा प्रत्युत्पन्नेन वर्तय ॥

meaning.en: 'Do not grieve at the time of grief, nor rejoice at the time of joy; leaving past and future, act in the present.'

verses.text:
मां चेदभ्यागतः कालः सदायुक्तमतन्द्रितम् ।
क्षमस्व नचिरादिन्द्र त्वामप्युपगमिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: 'If time has come upon me, who was always diligent and unwearied, bear it, Indra; before long it will come on you too.'

verses.text:
त्रासयन्निव देवेन्द्र वाग्भिस्तक्षसि मामिह ।
संयते मयि नूनं त्वमात्मानं बहु मन्यसे ॥

meaning.en: 'You cut at me here with words as though frightening me, lord of the gods; no doubt you think highly of yourself when I am bound.'

verses.text:
कालः प्रथममायान्मां पश्चात्त्वामनुधावति ।
तेन गर्जसि देवेन्द्र पूर्वं कालहते मयि ॥

meaning.en: 'Time came to me first, and then runs after you; therefore you roar, lord of gods, while I am struck by time.'

verses.text:
को हि स्थातुमलं लोके क्रुद्धस्य मम संयुगे ।
कालस्तु बलवान्प्राप्तस्तेन तिष्ठसि वासव ॥

meaning.en: 'Who in the world can stand before me in battle when I am angry? But mighty Time has come, and so you stand there, Vasava.'

verses.text:
यत्तद्वर्षसहस्रान्तं पूर्णं भवितुमर्हति ।
यथा मे सर्वगात्राणि नस्वस्थानि हतौजसः ॥

meaning.en: 'That which should be complete at the end of a thousand years: how all my limbs are unwell, my vigour struck.'

verses.text:
अहमैन्द्रच्च्युतः स्थानात्त्वमिन्द्रः प्रकृतो दिवि ।
सुचित्रे जीवलोकेऽस्मिन्नुपास्यः कालपर्ययात् ॥

meaning.en: 'I have fallen from Indra's place, and you are set as Indra in heaven; in this wondrous world of the living you are to be served, by the turn of time.'

verses.text:
किं हि कृत्वा त्वमिन्द्रोऽद्य किं हि कृत्वा च्युता वयम् ।
कालः कर्ता विकर्ता च सर्वमन्यदकारणम् ॥

meaning.en: 'What did you do to be Indra today, and what did we do to fall? Time is the maker and unmaker; all else is no cause.'

verses.text:
नाशं विनाशमैश्वर्यं सुखदुःखे भवाभवौ ।
विद्वान्प्राप्यैवमत्यर्थं न प्रहृष्येन्न च व्यथेत् ॥

meaning.en: 'Loss, destruction, lordship, pleasure and pain, being and non-being: the wise man, understanding this, would not exult or suffer greatly.'

verses.text:
त्वमेव हीन्द्र वेत्थास्मान्वेदाहं त्वां च वासव ।
विकत्थसे मां किं बद्धं कालेन निरपत्रप ॥

meaning.en: 'You alone know us, Indra, and I know you, Vasava. Why do you shamelessly brag to me, bound by time?'

verses.text:
त्वमेव हि पुरा वेत्थ यत्तदा पौरुषं मम ।
समरेषु च विक्रान्तं पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम् ॥

meaning.en: 'You yourself knew my manly valour in the past, and my prowess in wars; that is proof enough.'

verses.text:
आदित्याश्चैव रुद्राश्च साध्याश्च वसुभिः सह ।
मया विनिर्जिताः सर्वे मरुतश्च शचीपते ॥

meaning.en: 'Adityas, Rudras, Sadhyas with the Vasus, and Maruts, lord of Shachi: all were conquered by me.'

verses.text:
त्वमेव शक्र जानासि देवासुरसमागमे ।
समेता विबुधा भग्नास्तरसा समरे मया ॥

meaning.en: 'You yourself know, Indra, at the meeting of gods and asuras, the gods assembled and broken by me by force in battle.'

verses.text:
पर्वताश्चासकृत्क्षिप्ताः सवनाः सवनौकसः ।
सटङ्कशिखरा घोराः समरे मूर्ध्नि ते मया ॥

meaning.en: 'In battle I hurled mountains again and again at your head, with their forests, their dwellers, their cliffs and terrible peaks.'

verses.text:
किं नु शक्यं मया कर्तुं यत्कालो दुरतिक्रमः ।
न हि त्वां नोत्सहे हन्तुं सवज्रमपि मुष्टिना ॥

meaning.en: 'What can I do, since time is hard to cross? Else I would be able to strike you with my fist, thunderbolt and all.'

verses.text:
न तु विक्रमकालोऽयं क्षमाकालोऽयमागतः ।
तेन त्वा मर्षये शक्र दुर्मर्षणतरस्त्वया ॥

meaning.en: 'But this is not the time for valour; the time for patience has come. So I forbear you, Indra, though I am harder to bear than you.'

verses.text:
त्वं मा परिणते काले परीतं कालवह्निना ।
नियतं कालपाशेन बद्धं शक्र विकत्थसे ॥

meaning.en: 'You boast to me, seized by the fire of time at the ripe hour, and bound by the noose of time, Indra.'

verses.text:
अयं स पुरुषः श्यामो लोकस्य दुरतिक्रमः ।
बद्ध्वा तिष्ठति मां रौद्रः पशुं रशनया यथा ॥

meaning.en: 'This dark Person, hard for the world to cross, stands terrible, binding me as a beast with a rope.'

verses.text:
लाभालाभौ सुखं दुःखं कामक्रोधौ भवाभवौ ।
वधो बन्धः प्रमोक्षश्च सर्वं कालेन लभ्यते ॥

meaning.en: 'Gain and loss, pleasure and pain, desire and anger, being and non-being, killing, bondage and release: all is obtained through time.'

verses.text:
नाहं कर्ता न कर्ता त्वं कर्ता यस्तु सदा प्रभुः ।
सोऽयं पचति कालो मां वृक्षे फलमिवागतम् ॥

meaning.en: 'I am not the doer, and you are not the doer; the doer is the one who is always lord. This Time ripens me, like fruit on a tree.'

verses.text:
यान्येव पुरुषः कुर्वन्सुखैः कालेन युज्यते ।
पुनस्तान्येव कुर्वाणो दुःखैः कालेन युज्यते ॥

meaning.en: 'What a man does and is joined with pleasures by time, he does again and is joined by time with pains.'

verses.text:
न च कालेन कालज्ञः स्पृष्टः शोचितुमर्हति ।
तेन शक्र न शोचामि नास्ति शोके सहायता ॥

meaning.en: 'One who knows time and is touched by it should not grieve; so, Indra, I do not grieve; there is no help in grief.'

verses.text:
यदा हि शोचतां शोको व्यसनं नापकर्षति ।
सामर्थ्यं शोचतो नास्ति नाद्य शोचाम्यहं ततः ॥

meaning.en: 'Since for the grieving, grief does not remove calamity, and the grieving have no power, I do not grieve today.'

verses.text:
एवमुक्तः सहस्राक्षो भगवान्पाकशासनः ।
प्रतिसंहृत्य संरम्भमित्युवाच शतक्रतुः ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed, the thousand-eyed lord Indra, Shatakratu, withdrew his anger and said:

verses.text:
सवज्रमुद्यतं बाहुं दृष्ट्वा पाशांश्च वारुणान् ।
कस्येह न व्यथेद्बुद्धिर्मृत्योरपि जिघांसतः ॥

meaning.en: 'Seeing the arm raised with the thunderbolt and Varuna's nooses, whose mind here would not tremble, even before Death who wished to kill?'

verses.text:
सा ते न व्यथते बुद्धिरचला तत्त्वदर्शिनी ।
ब्रुवन्न व्यथसे स त्वं वाक्यं सत्यपराक्रम ॥

meaning.en: 'Your mind does not tremble: unshaken, seeing truth. Speaking, you do not tremble, you of true valour.'

verses.text:
को हि विश्वासमर्थेषु शरीरे वा शरीरभृत् ।
कर्तुमुत्सहते लोके दृष्ट्वा संप्रस्थितं जगत् ॥

meaning.en: 'Who among embodied beings, seeing the world in motion, can put trust in possessions or in the body?'

verses.text:
अहमप्येवमेवैनं लोकं जानाम्यशाश्वतम् ।
कालाग्नावाहितं घोरे गुह्ये सततगेऽक्षरे ॥

meaning.en: 'I too know this world to be impermanent, laid in the terrible fire of time, secret, ever-going, imperishable.'

verses.text:
न चात्र परिहारोऽस्ति कालस्पृष्टस्य कस्यचित् ।
सूक्ष्माणां महतां चैव भूतानां परिपच्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: 'There is no escape here for anyone touched by time, as small and great beings are cooked.'

verses.text:
अनीशस्याप्रमत्तस्य भूतानि पचतः सदा ।
अनिवृत्तस्य कालस्य क्षयं प्राप्तो न मुच्यते ॥

meaning.en: 'For one who cooks beings always, not a master, unwearied, time never turned back, no one who has reached destruction is released.'

verses.text:
अप्रमत्तः प्रमत्तेषु कालो जागर्ति देहिषु ।
प्रयत्नेनाप्यतिक्रान्तो दृष्टपूर्वो न केनचित् ॥

meaning.en: 'Time, awake among the careless, is not careless toward the embodied; no one has been seen to overcome it, even by effort.'

verses.text:
पुराणः शाश्वतो धर्मः सर्वप्राणभृतां समः ।
कालो न परिहार्यश्च न चास्यास्ति व्यतिक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: 'It is ancient, eternal dharma, the same for all living beings; time cannot be avoided and has no transgression.'

verses.text:
अहोरात्रांश्च मासांश्च क्षणान्काष्ठाः कला लवान् ।
संपिण्डयति नः कालो वृद्धिं वार्धुषिको यथा ॥

meaning.en: 'Days and nights, months, moments, kashthas, kalas and lavas: time heaps them together for us like a moneylender his interest.'

verses.text:
इदमद्य करिष्यामि श्वः कर्तास्मीति वादिनम् ।
कालो हरति संप्राप्तो नदीवेग इवोडुपम् ॥

meaning.en: 'To the one who says, I will do this today, I will do that tomorrow, time comes and carries him off, as a river's current carries off a raft.'

verses.text:
इदानीं तावदेवासौ मया दृष्टः कथं मृतः ।
इति कालेन ह्रियतां प्रलापः श्रूयते नृणाम् ॥

meaning.en: 'I saw him just now; how did he die? Such lamentation of men being carried off by time is heard.'

verses.text:
नश्यन्त्यर्थास्तथा भोगाः स्थानमैश्वर्यमेव च ।
अनित्यमध्रुवं सर्वं व्यवसायो हि दुष्करः ।
उच्छ्राया विनिपातान्ता भावोऽभावस्थ एव च ॥

meaning.en: 'Possessions perish, as do pleasures, rank and sovereignty; all is impermanent and unstable, and resolve is hard. Heights end in falling, and being rests in non-being.'

verses.text:
सा ते न व्यथते बुद्धिरचला तत्त्वदर्शिनी ।
अहमासं पुरा चेति मनसापि न बुध्यसे ॥

meaning.en: 'That mind of yours does not tremble, unshaken, seeing truth. You do not even think in your mind, I was once such.'

verses.text:
कालेनाक्रम्य लोकेऽस्मिन्पच्यमाने बलीयसा ।
अज्येष्ठमकनिष्ठं च क्षिप्यमाणो न बुध्यसे ॥

meaning.en: 'In this world, seized and ripened by mighty time, you do not mind being cast down, neither eldest nor youngest.'

verses.text:
ईर्ष्याभिमानलोभेषु कामक्रोधभयेषु च ।
स्पृहामोहाभिमानेषु लोकः सक्तो विमुह्यति ॥

meaning.en: 'In envy, pride and greed, in desire, anger and fear, in craving, delusion and conceit, the world is attached and bewildered.'

verses.text:
भवांस्तु भावतत्त्वज्ञो विद्वाञ्ज्ञानतपोन्वितः ।
कालं पश्यति सुव्यक्तं पाणावामलकं यथा ॥

meaning.en: 'But you know the truth of existence; learned, endowed with knowledge and austerity, you see time clearly, like an amalak fruit in the palm.'

verses.text:
कालचारित्रतत्त्वज्ञः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः ।
वैरोचने कृतात्मासि स्पृहणीयो विजानताम् ॥

meaning.en: 'Knowing the truth of time's course, expert in all scriptures, son of Virochana, you are a perfected soul, to be envied by those who know.'

verses.text:
सर्वलोको ह्ययं मन्ये बुद्ध्या परिगतस्त्वया ।
विहरन्सर्वतोमुक्तो न क्वचित्परिषज्जसे ॥

meaning.en: 'I think you have grasped the whole world with your understanding. Moving about, free on all sides, you are attached nowhere.'

verses.text:
रजश्च हि तमश्च त्वा स्पृशतो न जितेन्द्रियम् ।
निष्प्रीतिं नष्टसंतापं त्वमात्मानमुपाससे ॥

meaning.en: 'Rajas and tamas do not touch you, whose senses are conquered; without delight, your torment gone, you worship the self.'

verses.text:
सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां निर्वैरं शान्तमानसम् ।
दृष्ट्वा त्वां मम संजाता त्वय्यनुक्रोशिनी मतिः ॥

meaning.en: 'Seeing you, friend of all beings, free of hatred, of calm mind, I have felt compassion for you.'

verses.text:
नाहमेतादृशं बुद्धं हन्तुमिच्छामि बन्धने ।
आनृशंस्यं परो धर्मो अनुक्रोशस्तथा त्वयि ॥

meaning.en: 'I do not wish to strike one such as you, wise, in bonds. Gentleness is the highest dharma, and compassion toward you.'

verses.text:
मोक्ष्यन्ते वारुणाः पाशास्तवेमे कालपर्ययात् ।
प्रजानामपचारेण स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु महासुर ॥

meaning.en: 'These nooses of Varuna will be loosened for you by the turn of time, through the misconduct of the people. May you be well, great asura.'

verses.text:
यदा श्वश्रूं स्नुषा वृद्धां परिचारेण योक्ष्यते ।
पुत्रश्च पितरं मोहात्प्रेषयिष्यति कर्मसु ॥

meaning.en: 'When a daughter-in-law will make her old mother-in-law serve her, and a son, from delusion, will send his father to do tasks,'

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणैः कारयिष्यन्ति वृषलाः पादधावनम् ।
शूद्राश्च ब्राह्मणीं भार्यामुपयास्यन्ति निर्भयाः ॥

meaning.en: 'when low men will make Brahmanas wash their feet, and Shudras will approach Brahmin wives without fear,'

verses.text:
वियोनिषु च बीजानि मोक्ष्यन्ते पुरुषा यदा ।
संकरं कांस्यभाण्डैश्च बलिं चापि कुपात्रकैः ॥

meaning.en: 'when men will sow seed in the wrong wombs, and offer the mixed rites with bronze vessels and offerings with poor pots,'

verses.text:
चातुर्वर्ण्यं यदा कृत्स्नमुन्मर्यादं भविष्यति ।
एकैकस्ते तदा पाशः क्रमशः प्रतिमोक्ष्यते ॥

meaning.en: 'when the whole fourfold order will be without limit, then one by one your nooses will be released.'

verses.text:
अस्मत्तस्ते भयं नास्ति समयं प्रतिपालय ।
सुखी भव निराबाधः स्वस्थचेता निरामयः ॥

meaning.en: 'You have nothing to fear from us; keep your agreement. Be happy, undisturbed, calm in mind, free of illness.'

verses.text:
तमेवमुक्त्वा भगवाञ्शतक्रतुः
प्रतिप्रयातो गजराजवाहनः ।
विजित्य सर्वानसुरान्सुराधिपो
ननन्द हर्षेण बभूव चैकराट् ॥

meaning.en: Having so spoken to him, the lord Shatakratu went back, riding the king of elephants; having conquered all the asuras, the lord of the gods rejoiced with delight and became sole king.

verses.text:
महर्षयस्तुष्टुवुरञ्जसा च तं
वृषाकपिं सर्वचराचरेश्वरम् ।
हिमापहो हव्यमुदावहंस्त्वरं-
स्तथामृतं चार्पितमीश्वराय ह ॥

meaning.en: The great sages quickly praised him, Vrishakapi, lord of all things moving and unmoving; the one who removes the cold, carrying the offering swiftly, and nectar too were offered to the lord.

verses.text:
द्विजोत्तमैः सर्वगतैरभिष्टुतो
विदीप्ततेजा गतमन्युरीश्वरः ।
प्रशान्तचेता मुदितः स्वमालयं
त्रिविष्टपं प्राप्य मुमोद वासवः ॥

meaning.en: Praised by the best of the twice-born everywhere, his radiance blazing, his anger gone, the lord Indra, calm in mind and glad, reached his own abode in heaven and rejoiced.
